coverage: Initial verified Sofia selection, not a complete city agenda. Municipal and tourism sources were checked first, then full official opera, philharmonic, gallery and festival programmes. The tourism origin presented a challenge; accessible municipal reference pages and independent organizer evidence are distinguished in the research audit. Calendar-only expected endings are not actual finishes. Exhibition visiting windows are separate from performances. Some categories and dates remain sparse. Public Telegram announcement and chat attempts returned unavailable pages, not readable posts; zero imports and no joining.
description: Sourced venue selection. A directory entry does not confirm opening today; check the venue before visiting.
